name: home-cleaning
description: Cleaners clean people's homes, by the hour or per visit, often every week.

description.description: The cleaning: what is cleaned, and how.

price.description: The price per hour or per visit, or for the whole job.

base.description: The area the cleaner works in.

frequency.description: How often the home is cleaned; biweekly is every two weeks.

hours.description: When the cleaning can be done, each week.

time.description: When the cleaning is wanted, or first wanted if it repeats: a time, or a span to fit it in.
